```{python}
    sensor_dataframe = pd.read_csv(path)

    all_sensor_data[name] = {
        "df": temperature_df,
        "shadows": shadow_data_by_sensor[name].set_index("timestamp").reindex(temperature_df.index)
    }
```

We'll need to make sure to only consider months where there is enough data. 
```{python}

def is_inside_interval(interval, date):
    start, end = interval
    crosses_new_year = (start.month, start.day) > (end.month, end.day)
    if crosses_new_year:
        return start.is_bigger_or_equal_than(date) or end.is_less_or_equal_than(date)

    return start.is_bigger_or_equal_than(date) and end.is_less_or_equal_than(date)
```

### Computing the differences
```{python}

#Find indices common to both arrays
def get_included_indices(reference_values, tested_values):
    n = len(tested_values)
    included_indices = []
    filtered_values = []

    for i in range(0,n):
        tested_value = tested_values[i]
        if(tested_value in reference_values):
            filtered_values.append(tested_value)
            included_indices.append(i)
        
    
    return included_indices, filtered_values

#We pick Boston World Series Way as the reference sensor, because this is the one that was always in the shade.

REFERENCE_SENSOR = "Boston World Series Way"
ANALYZED_SENSORS = ["Boston Robinson Hall", "Boston Gainsborough Parking Garage"]




def calculate_differences(season_test_dictionary, season_ref_dictionary):
    #Timestamps are the indices
    reference_timestamps = set(season_ref_dictionary["df"].index)
    analyzed_sensor_timestamps = list(season_test_dictionary["df"].index)
    #Check the time overlap
    included_indices, filtered_values = get_included_indices(
        reference_values = reference_timestamps,
        tested_values = analyzed_sensor_timestamps
    )

    all_temperature_values = list(season_test_dictionary["df"]["temperature"])
    temperature_differences = []
    for i in range(0,len(included_indices)):
        index = included_indices[i]
        timestamp = analyzed_sensor_timestamps[index]
        reference_temperature = season_ref_dictionary["df"].loc[timestamp, "temperature"]
        temperature = all_temperature_values[index]
        temperature_delta = temperature - reference_temperature
        temperature_differences.append(temperature_delta)
    
    season_test_dictionary["temperature_diffs"] = temperature_differences
    season_test_dictionary["diff_timestamps"] = filtered_values

    shadow_values_0m = list(season_test_dictionary["shadows"]["shadow_radius_0m"])
    filtered_shadows = [shadow_values_0m[index] for index in included_indices]
    season_test_dictionary["filtered_shadows_0m"] = filtered_shadows



for season in SEASON_KEYS:
    reference_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_season[season][REFERENCE_SENSOR]
    for i in range(0,len(ANALYZED_SENSORS)):
        analyzed_sensor_name = ANALYZED_SENSORS[i]
        analyzed_sensor_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_season[season][analyzed_sensor_name]

        calculate_differences(
            season_test_dictionary = analyzed_sensor_dictionary,
            season_ref_dictionary = reference_dictionary
        )

for month in MONTH_KEYS:
    reference_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_month[month][REFERENCE_SENSOR]
    for i in range(0,len(ANALYZED_SENSORS)):
        analyzed_sensor_name = ANALYZED_SENSORS[i]
        analyzed_sensor_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_month[month][analyzed_sensor_name]
        
        calculate_differences(
            season_test_dictionary = analyzed_sensor_dictionary,
            season_ref_dictionary = reference_dictionary
        )


print(all_sensor_data_by_season["Summer"][ANALYZED_SENSORS[0]]["temperature_diffs"])
```


### Splitting days and night hours
```{python}
MODEL_RADII = [0,50,100]
shadow_columns = [f"shadow_radius_{radius}m" for radius in MODEL_RADII]


def split_day_and_night(
        sensor_dictionary
    ):

    model_df = sensor_dictionary["shadows"].loc[sensor_dictionary["diff_timestamps"], shadow_columns]
    model_df["temperature_diff"] = sensor_dictionary["temperature_diffs"]
    model_df = model_df.dropna(subset = ["temperature_diff"])
    model_df["date"] = model_df.index.tz_localize("UTC").tz_convert("America/New_York").date

    is_day = model_df["shadow_radius_0m"].notna()
    sensor_dictionary["day_hours"] = model_df[is_day]
    sensor_dictionary["night_hours"] = model_df[~is_day]

    hour_counts= {
        "day hours in the sun": int((model_df["shadow_radius_0m"] == 1).sum()),
        "day hours in the shadow": int((model_df["shadow_radius_0m"] == 0).sum()),
        "night hours": int((~is_day).sum())
    }

    sensor_dictionary["hour_counts"] = hour_counts

for i in range(0,len(SEASON_KEYS)):
    season = SEASON_KEYS[i]
    for j in range(0,len(ANALYZED_SENSORS)):
        sensor_name = ANALYZED_SENSORS[j]
        sensor_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_season[season][sensor_name]
        split_day_and_night(
            sensor_dictionary = sensor_dictionary
        )



for i in range(0,len(MONTH_KEYS)):
    month = MONTH_KEYS[i]
    for j in range(0,len(ANALYZED_SENSORS)):
        sensor_name = ANALYZED_SENSORS[j]
        sensor_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_month[month][sensor_name]
        split_day_and_night(
            sensor_dictionary = sensor_dictionary
        )
```

### Training the models

```{python}
models_by_season_by_sensor = {}
models_by_month_by_sensor = {}


def get_models_for_dictionary(data_dictionary):
    models_per_radius = []
    day_hours_df = data_dictionary["day_hours"]
    for radius in MODEL_RADII:
        day_hours_at_radius = day_hours_df.assign(
            shadow_value = day_hours_df[f"shadow_radius_{radius}m"]
        )
        model = smf.ols("temperature_diff ~ shadow_value", data = day_hours_at_radius).fit(
                cov_type = "cluster", 
                cov_kwds = {"groups": day_hours_at_radius["date"]}
            )
        
        models_per_radius.append(model)
    
    return models_per_radius


for i in range(0,len(SEASON_KEYS)):
    season = SEASON_KEYS[i]

    for j in range(0,len(ANALYZED_SENSORS)):
        sensor_name = ANALYZED_SENSORS[j]
        sensor_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_season[season][sensor_name]
        models_per_radius = get_models_for_dictionary(
            data_dictionary = sensor_dictionary
        )

        all_sensor_data_by_season[season][sensor_name]["models"] = models_per_radius


for i in range(0,len(MONTH_KEYS)):
    month = MONTH_KEYS[i]

    for j in range(0,len(ANALYZED_SENSORS)):
        sensor_name = ANALYZED_SENSORS[j]
        sensor_dictionary = all_sensor_data_by_month[month][sensor_name]
        models_per_radius = get_models_for_dictionary(
            data_dictionary = sensor_dictionary
        )

        all_sensor_data_by_month[month][sensor_name]["models"] = models_per_radius




```

### b1 coefficients per season
```{python}
# Plotting the b1 coefficients for each season and each radius

def plot_b1_coefficients(sensor_data_by_period, radius_index):
    period_keys = list(sensor_data_by_period.keys())
    radius = MODEL_RADII[radius_index]
    distribution_dictionaries = []
    for i in range(0,len(ANALYZED_SENSORS)):
        sensor_name = ANALYZED_SENSORS[i]
        all_values = []
        p_values = []
        for j in range(0,len(period_keys)):
            period = period_keys[j]
            sensor_dictionary = sensor_data_by_period[period][sensor_name]
            all_values.append(sensor_dictionary["models"][radius_index].params.iloc[1])
            p_values.append(float(sensor_dictionary["models"][radius_index].pvalues.iloc[1]))

        distribution_dictionary = {
            "x": period_keys,
            "y": all_values,
            "color_bars": cmc.batlow(i/(len(SENSOR_KEYS) - 1)),
            "label": sensor_name
        }

        distribution_dictionaries.append(distribution_dictionary)

        print(f"P-values of {sensor_name}, radius {radius} m: {p_values}")

    ax = distribution_plotter.multi_distribution_plotter(
        distributions = distribution_dictionaries,
        width = 16,
        height = 4,
        title = f"b1 coefficients, radius {radius} m",
        variable_name = "b1",
        values_on_top = False,
        decimals = 0
    )


for k in range(0,len(MODEL_RADII)):
    plot_b1_coefficients(
        sensor_data_by_period = all_sensor_data_by_season,
        radius_index = k
    )
```
